changelog: Spoken punctuation now understands the ellipsis and the slash: say "ellipsis" (or "dot dot dot") and … appears at the end of your trailing-off sentence — handy for pauses in a dictated story. Say "slash" (or "forward slash") and / glues the words on both sides, for and/or alternatives and dates. In Bengali, say "ত্রিবিন্দু" for … and "বিকল্পচিহ্ন" for /. Works in the app and in the voice keyboard, only when the spoken-punctuation setting is on.
